criterion: From the landing refusals: the end-to-end doctor tests still fail when a probe that answered in time is dropped. The live-session and new-zsh checks run through the real process-table read and a real zsh (no injected seam in tests/doctor_test.py), and the only accepted alternative to the healthy answer is the named not-checked row.
evidence: Real wiring, no injected answer. util/doctor_test.go:176 TestDoctorRouteReadsAnOpenSessionThroughTheProcessTable runs DoctorRoute against a held adapter process through the real process-table read, with five cases. shim-only: no child. translator-running: a real child whose kernel argv[0] is /opt/bin/cliproxyapi, started by the hold (util/sharedbridge_test.go:325 holdChild, CCMORPH_TEST_HOLD_CHILD); with a saved, unclassified model the report must be exactly 'OK adapter: this profile needs a translator now: an open session on it is running cliproxyapi'. translator-running-classified: the same child with a known need; the report must be exactly the row with the suffix '; an open session on this profile is using one now'. translator-and-hooks-shim and translator-and-hooks-shim-classified (util/doctor_test.go:196-199): the same two rows with the cliproxyapi child beside a separate hooks-shim child, a CCMORPH_SHIM_HOOKS build; each case first checks the read session holds every child (212). All five pass, also under umask 077 (.hive/go-live-translator.log). Mutation E, the landing refusal's case, makes DoctorRoute pass __UNKNOWN__ to adapterLine for a successfully read cliproxyapi session in the default report only, leaving verbose alone. Both translator cases then fail ('adapter rows [] ...' and the row without its suffix) while shim-only passes (.hive/mutation.log). Mutation F does the same only for a session with a :hooks-shim child; the two hooks-shim cases fail and the other three pass (.hive/mutation.log). Mutation B: cutting the whole read ('running := "__UNKNOWN__"') fails the same test. Dropping the real zsh's answer ('c.bound = answered && bound && false') fails cli/doctor_completion_test.go:77 TestDoctorCompletionSaysOnlyWhatANewZshStillMisses (real zsh, 60 s deadline). Both pass unmutated (.hive/mutation-control.log, go-live-translator.log). The forced timeout is tested separately: TestDoctorRouteNamesASessionReadThatLostItsBound. No seam: the tests/doctor_test.py diff has no monkeypatch or CCMORPH_*BOUND/DEADLINE/TIMEOUT/FAKE, and 'git grep doctorSessionRead|doctorCompletionProbe' finds no code (its only match is this evidence text).
